title: Correct radius r1
description: Essential Criteria: The radius r1 must be accurately calculated as 0.707 mm.

title: Intensity calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The intensity at the spot must be expressed correctly as 16I0.

title: Maxima locations
description: Essential Criteria: The expected locations of intensity maxima must be correctly identified as 1/3 m, 1/5 m, 1/7 m, etc.

title: Use of equations
description: Important Criteria: The relevant equations for focal lengths and intensity must be correctly applied.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistently used throughout the calculations.

title: Sign errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that no factors are omitted in the intensity calculation.
